editorial:
Ever wonder what happens when science goes totally wrong and you start turning into a giant bug? You are stepping back into the gross and scary world of the original classic, but with a fresh spin. This story follows a new set of characters dealing with the messy fallout of teleportation experiments. The vibe is creepy and tense, making you feel like something is always crawling just out of sight. You will feel for the main characters as they try to hold onto their humanity while their bodies literally fall apart in the most disgusting ways possible.

What really works here is the makeup and the way the tension builds up. The acting is solid, and the surprises keep you guessing until the very end. Some parts might feel a bit slow, but the gross-out moments make up for it. If you love body horror, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the main character fully transforms into a monster. You see a final struggle where the human side of the creature tries to fight the bug instincts. In the end, the lab is destroyed to stop the mutation from spreading to the rest of the city. The twist is that a small piece of the creature survives, meaning the nightmare is not actually over for everyone.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves gross monster movies and sci-fi twists.
